notes: Fund-clearing loop 2026-10-15 (ncx sandboxes). The undimensioned us-gaap InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue / AtCost changes meaning between filings: in the 10-Qs from 2023-03-31 to 2025-09-30 (not the 2024 10-K) it is the schedule's 'Total Investments' line, which includes the money-market cash equivalents (2023: one un-itemised 'Cash Equivalents (14)' line; from 2023-12-31 the itemised money-market rows); in the 2024 10-K and from 2025-12-31 it excludes them (the filer then tags the with-cash total as ncpif:InvestmentOwnedFairValueAndCashEquivalentsAtFairValue). The wrapper's source_encodings.investments_total_excludes = cash_rows says the investments figure leaves the cash rows out, so the figures below put the with-cash quarters on the same basis: the balance sheet's 'Non-controlled/non-affiliate company investments, at fair value (amortized cost of ...)' line, which excludes cash equivalents in every filing.
